nodes.text: Keep the route to the altar clear.

Build a stylized elven courtyard in a rocky, wooded valley under soft daylight. Place two round homes with domed roofs and arched entrances on opposite sides of a circular stone plaza. Center a stone altar topped with blue crystals on the plaza. A broad front stair and ornamental arch form the approach, with railings beside the stair and along the plaza edges. Add benches and lanterns. Group trees and rocks behind the homes, with grass, flowers, mushrooms, and ivy around the pale stone architecture. Keep the route to the altar clear.
